title: Nashville’s 1st Prohibition Cocktail Crawl: Secrets & Scandals
includes: Stroll sin-soaked streets & hear shocking-but-true tales.
Discover local venues with occasional tour-only specials.
Join a Jazz Age–steeped guide: historian, toastmaster, ringleader!
Snap Insta-worthy shots in hidden nooks & glam spots.
Drinks & food – Pay as you go and ONLY buy what you want! Drinking is not required! (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Nashville’s Original Prohibition Cocktail Crawl explores downtown’s jazz-era nightlife, hidden-gem bars, and true stories from a sin-soaked past. Small groups and pay-as-you-go drinks keep it flexible, fun, and full of Gatsby-era mischief.

Please note: this is a Prohibition-themed cocktail crawl, NOT a speakeasy-only tour. Nashville does not have enough true speakeasies near each other to create a walkable route. Instead, we visit a curated mix of historic, hidden-gem, and era-inspired venues for history, cocktails, and lots of laughter.

In two hours, your host leads you to four downtown venues with stories of bootleggers, corruption, and clever workarounds that kept the spirits flowing.

Drinks are optional and à la carte; some venues may offer specials or preferred pricing, but discounts are not guaranteed at every stop. The walk is under a mile and relaxed—ideal for groups, couples, bachelorettes, and curious travelers who like cocktails with crazy-but-true history!
